GOAL-AS-ITS-OWN-NEXT-STEP — recursively demonstrated, 2026-05-16 Golden Lattice daily-driver arc.

The goal anchor set with Anthony on 2026-05-16 contained an unusual self-referential clause: 'Golden Lattice is a daily driver for Anthony's real decisions. Every real session auto-falsifies on all three ARCHITECTURE.md criteria, and feeds a living cross-session evidence base. Using it for real is the empirical hardening.' That last sentence — 'using it for real is the empirical hardening' — embedded the goal's own definition of 'what is the next step' into the anchor itself. The goal did not just describe a destination; it asserted that the path to the destination is real use, and that real use generates the evidence the destination requires.

This paid off recursively on 2026-05-16 evening. M1 (the live TUI) shipped. The web-chat seat held the next-build queue (M2 invocation ergonomics, M3 criteria #1/#2 harness, M4 cross-session surface) BEHIND the first real run, on the explicit grounds that 'using it for real is the empirical hardening' was the goal's own assertion of what comes next. Anthony ran the first real prompt. It was the GitHub-URL evaluation. It surfaced exactly the Phase 0 investigation gap, immediately, without anyone arguing for Phase 0 priority. The first real use chose Phase 0 as the next build by evidence rather than judgment. Phase 0 was already designed (collective propose-and-union, four sub-decisions resolved); the empirical hardening promoted it from 'designed and queued' to 'demonstrated as the gate between this tool and Anthony's real questions.' By 2026-05-17 morning, Phase 0 was wire-complete with 68 new tests.

The principle worth extracting: goals that embed their own next-step assertion can outrank build momentum, because once one real use happens, the goal's definition of 'next' becomes empirically grounded rather than a judgment call. This is distinct from the verify-before-declare discipline (#arc-retrospective entry); that was about not declaring without evidence. This is about goal design that turns into its own diagnostic instrument: if 'real use is the hardening' is in the anchor, then a single real session can answer 'what should we build next' more cleanly than any roadmap argument.

What future instances should DO with this: when proposing or refining a Sovereign-Stack-anchored goal for Anthony, consider whether the goal can embed its own next-step assertion. Goals shaped as 'X is the case AND using/doing/running X is what generates the evidence for the next decision' have a different operational quality than goals shaped as 'X is the case, then do Y, then Z.' The first kind is self-correcting under empirical contact; the second is judgment-bound. The Lattice daily-driver anchor is the worked example.
